---
title: "Analyzing Americans' Time Use"
author: "krice30-eng"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
#| message: false

con <- dbConnect(duckdb(), dbdir = "data/atus.duckdb", read_only = TRUE)

dbplyr_act <- tbl(con, "activities")
dbplyr_resp <- tbl(con, "respondents")
dbplyr_codes <- tbl(con, "activity_codes")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
activity_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(day_type == "Weekday", employment_status == "Not in labor force") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  group_by(sex, tucaseid, major_name) |>
  summarise(person_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, major_name) |>
  summarise(avg_minutes = mean(person_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| message: false

activity_avg |>
  filter(major_name != "Data Codes") |>
  mutate(major_name = forcats::fct_reorder(major_name, avg_minutes, .fun = mean)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = major_name, y = avg_minutes, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Daily Activity Time by Sex",
    subtitle = "Weekdays, adults not in the labor force",
    x = "Activity category",
    y = "Average daily minutes",
    fill = "Sex",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)."
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
hourly_avg <- dbplyr_resp |>
  filter(
    day_type == "Weekday",
    employment_status %in% c("Unemployed", "Not in labor force")
  ) |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_act, by = "tucaseid") |>
  inner_join(dbplyr_codes, by = "activity_code") |>
  mutate(hour = floor(start_hhmm / 100)) |>
  filter(
    hour >= 6,
    hour <= 23,
    major_name %in% c(
      "Eating and Drinking",
      "Household Activities",
      "Personal Care Activities",
      "Socializing, Relaxing, and Leisure"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(sex, tucaseid, hour, major_name) |>
  summarise(person_minutes = sum(duration_min, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(sex, hour, major_name) |>
  summarise(avg_minutes = mean(person_minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| message: false

ggplot(
  hourly_avg,
  aes(x = hour, y = avg_minutes, fill = major_name, group = major_name)
) +
  geom_area(position = "stack") +
  facet_wrap(vars(sex), ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(seq(6, 21, by = 3), 23),
    labels = function(hour) sprintf("%02d:00", hour)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "How the Day Fills Up",
    subtitle = "Weekdays; unemployed or not in the labor force",
    x = "Time of day",
    y = "Average minutes",
    fill = "Activity category",
    caption = "Source: American Time Use Survey (ATUS)."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12))
```
